summary: Initialize M1 non-notch context and guidelines
description: Created CONTEXT.md defining MacBook M1 non-notch constraints (safeAreaInsets.top == 0, dynamic menu bar height alignment, hover bounds) and codebase architecture rules.

Added a freeform Notion-style block editor inside the notch canvas with slash commands (/), instant markdown checklist triggers ([]), interactive checkboxes with strikethrough, atomic debounced JSON persistence, notch dismissal protection while editing, and a dedicated Settings pane.

summary: Add GitHub Actions automated app build workflow
description: Added .github/workflows/build_app.yml to automatically build, ad-hoc sign, and package boringNotch into a downloadable zip artifact on push.

summary: Fix window key focus, dismissal lifecycle, tab transitions, and scratchpad typing
description: Enabled canBecomeKey=true on BoringNotchWindow and BoringNotchSkyLightWindow, added Esc key (keyCode 53) and global mouse click-outside dismissal monitors, removed buggy preventNotchClose state locking, implemented macOS 14+ onKeyPress for arrow keys and backspace navigation in NotchPadBlockRow, and smoothed currentView tab transitions.
